name: Enemigo íntimo
description: The story of two siblings who witness the murder of their parents in the hands of one of the drug cartels in Mexico, after which Alejandro Ferrer's younger sister is kidnapped. 25 years later, Alejandro is now the captain of the Federal Police and seeks revenge against the narcos for destroying his family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Captain Alejandro Ferrer arrives to detain Montalvo, a banker linked to the Mil Cumbres cartel, but he finds Roxana Rodiles, who launders money.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Alejandro presses Roxana to confess about Montalvo and money laundering. Borges wants revenge on the guard who killed Dulcita.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: La Mamba and la Puma fight over Roxana. The cartel has Alejandro in its sights. Dulcita's death is avenged and the inmates of Las Dunas celebrate.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Alejandro suggests that Daniel infiltrate Las Dunas. Carlos is ambushed and taken down. The captain and the FBI have a plan to mislead the media.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Daniel assumes the criminal identity of Tilapia; however, Madre insists on giving him a rough welcome. A thug is hired to get rid of Alejandro.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The federal agent turns up the charm to seduce Roxana, who already feels a strong attraction towards Tilapia. She is then forced to start a fire.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Borges and Zambrano want Roxana to hand over the mastermind behind the fire. Tilapia is forced to kill Rocas to continue his covert operation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tilapia stabs an inmate to gain Madre's trust. Alejandro goes after the man who killed his parents. El Profesor demands that Roxana not be touched.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Tilapia is granted a conjugal visit. Zoraida suggests to Guillotina that he make La Perfumada his new girlfriend. Alejandro meets his parents' killer.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Madre sets a trap for the undercover agent to see if he has made alliances with the prison director. Roxana and la Cubana agree to keep a secret.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Los Oscuros take the captain and the lawyer Keller, throwing a wrench in plans to free Roxana. Alejandro meets Lula Pineda, a human rights defender.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Roxana vows to castrate Bowser in his sleep if he messes with her. Tilapia agrees to sell drugs in prison. Alejandro orders Marimar be investigated.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Roxana discovers that the only person she trusts wants her dead. Alejandro orders a microphone placed in the assistant DA's office.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After la Cubana's attack, Roxana becomes paranoid and begins to doubt Tilapia. Guillotina hands a poem to Roxana and promises her protection.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Daniel goes to bed with Roxana to elicit information from her, but she is placed in solitary confinement straight after for assaulting another inmate.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The head prison guard tells Daniel that he will rape Roxana. Alejandro interrogates Orejas. Zoraida plans a conjugal visit for la Perfumada.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Fresh memories of Roxana's childhood come crashing back. Guillotina threatens to castrate Tilapia if he comes near Roxana.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The brothers meet again. The captain warns Roxana that he won't stop until he finds her. Bowser visits her in solitary and she threatens to kill him.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Los Oscuros kidnap Olivia and demand Ferrer exchange her for Roxana. Don Nemesio and Guillotina maneuver to find out who Eduardo "Tilapia" Tapia is.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The head of Las Dunas and her inmates corner Roxana, who confronts them. Daniel is in danger because Madre suspects that he is a policeman.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ferrer takes la Puma to Mexico. The inmates beat Roxana before she asks for a conjugal visit with Guillotina in exchange for protection.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Rodiles spends the night with the head inmate; unbeknownst to him, a trap has been set. In exchange, she seeks protection against Zoraida.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Bowser mistreats Daniel, who threatens to reveal his affair with La Mamba. The witness who was set to divulge more info on Mil Cumbres is killed.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Tilapia makes a scene out of jealousy over Guillotina's conjugal visit. Alejandro spends the night with Marimar. Príamo is aware of the espionage.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The founder of Mil Cumbres cartel discovers who Tapia is and orders Guillotina to kill him. An attempt is made against Príamo, but it's a trick.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Tilapia wins the fight against Madre after delivering several blows. Roxana is taken out of Las Dunas to be interrogated, but disappears.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Don Nemesio manages to get his daughter brought to him and together they plot a strategy to gain her freedom.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Daniel and Roxana, face to face, avoid telling their interrogators the truth. Guillotina is punished and Borges is the only one to dare imprison him.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Borges and Minerva have a tragic accident. Alejandro is outraged by the announcement of immediate replacement. Roxana seeks Tilapia's protection.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Roxana and Tilapia believe they are alone in the library but Guillotina catches them in flagrante. Cordero works on Roxana's file.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Luis enters Las Dunas in disguise. Tilapia asks for Guillotina's forgiveness, but this is actually a trick to get rid of him.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Tilapia seduces Roxana and elicits information about Borges' death. Alejandro tracks Sansón, his parents' killer.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Guillotina orders Tilapia to have a conjugal visit with Clarisa in order to forget about Roxana. Lula looks for el Gato to bring Ferrer down.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: An intruder kills Príamo, an ally of Mil Cumbres and makes it look like a suicide. Roxana convinces Madre to not compete with Tilapia.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Nemesio's move to get Roxana out of Las Dunas comes crashing down with Príamo's departure. Now father and daughter will have to make a new strategy.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Not knowing that Alejandro is her brother, Roxana states that the agent tortured her, and as a result, Ferrer is forced to testify.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Alejandro insists on investigating the narcos, and Mil Cumbres take revenge on him. Roxana and Tilapia dance in secret. She cancels the escape plan.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Tilapia kills the head prison guard because Bowser tells him that he knows his true identity. Alejandro confronts Sansón at gunpoint.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Sansón confesses that Guillotina killed Alejandro's parents and Nemesio took his sister to sell her in the U.S. Tilapia doesn't want to leave Roxana.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: An attempt is made on Tilapia's life on Guillotina's orders. Ochún cannot finish with Roxana. La Mamba, her accomplice, is stabbed by la Puma.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Roxana wants to know why she has nightmares, and Guillotina forces her into sex. Zoraida promises to kill la Perfumada.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Zoraida and Roxana make a pact. Nemesio threatens Guillotina for messing with his daughter. The judge's order arrives to free Tilapia and Roxana.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: La Cubana brings Roxana to safety and is burned in the explosion she prepared to avenge the death of her boyfriend. Guillotina provokes Tilapia.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Tilapia sticks a dagger in Guillotina's neck to prevent him from brutally attacking Roxana. Tilapia and Roxana will be released in 48 hours.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: The inmates, convinced that Tilapia murdered Guillotina, corner him in an attempt to do away with him. A blood sample is taken from Roxana.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: With no evidence against them, Roxana and Tilapia go free. She aims a gun at him to force him to tell her who he really is. La Puma kills Zoraida.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Daniel admits to Roxana that his mission was to obtain information about the Professor but that he ended up falling in love. Nemesio threatens Daniel.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The board of the Mil Cumbres cartel and its partners, headed by Roxana, decide to go from drugs to diamonds. Daniel participates in everything.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Ferrer tries to use Daniel to catch Roxana, but he refuses. The real estate business in Miami serves to help the cartel launder money.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Daniel answers a call from Captain Ferrer. Roxana discovers that her partners are in charge of running guns into Mexico.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Roxana causes a mass flight, the end of Las Dunas is announced and Puma is freed as a reward for her loyalty. Guillotina recruits a new assassins.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: At the head of his new cartel, los Jinetes Jíbaros, Guillotina swears to slaughter Nemesio, Roxana, and Tilapia.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Roxana flees from the shooting in the Mil Cumbres hacienda. She calls her brother Alejandro and confesses who she is. Luis wounds Daniel and flees.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The rivalry between Roxana Rodiles and Alejandro Ferrer has no limit. Daniel is ready to run away with her and revamp the Mil Cumbres cartel in Spain.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: El Berebere threatens to kill Roxana's friend unless they meet. Rodiles has a plan and sends Ferrer a package. Martín wants a stake in the business.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Behind bars, Puma becomes critical to the investigation and capture of Berebere. Ferrer is not the only one after Rodiles and teams up with Camacho.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Camacho ensures all in Vigo know Roxana's face. The Professor's lawyer recommends staying away from the police. Ferrer pressures el Habanero and Abel.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Roxana and her men execute the plan in two phases, but they need the help and complicity of many others, including Martín. The police chase expands.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Roxana Rodiles puts a surprising spin into her strategy. Ferrer tries to get her to smuggle cocaine to Spain, and eventually get out of the business.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: All set up in her new operation center in Las Dunas, Roxana sends for Puma. Ferrer, outraged, believes something big is hiding behind all this.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Loyalty is part of Rodiles' company recruitment plan. Ferrer says she may be able to fool the government, the press and everyone else, but not him.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Alan and Ricardo meet with Rivera, but Alejandro surprises them. They ask him hard questions about his alleged ties with the Professor and Santilla.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Roxana learns that la Mariscala has a business in jail and may be useful to her company. Mass production will serve as a platform for transportation.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Rivera proposes a deal with Alejandro: in exchange for valuable information, he wants to enter the witness protection program. Will he betray Roxana?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Everything has a price, even ending Roxana's life. La Nana accepts the mission entrusted to her by la Mariscala and prepares the attack.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Roxana needs to finish the outline for her business and welcomes a guest to form a strategic alliance. Don Jesús takes the reins of Los Zopilotes.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Roxana erases the initial evidence of the business and closes her circle of trust in prison. Alicia is left out, but must get info to save her mother.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Martín reports the alliance is made, but Roxana fears a woman will ruin the plan. Alejandro confirms his suspicions about the business in Las Dunas.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Alicia sends vital information to El Habanero, and Don Jesús plans an operation to attack Roxana's warehouse. The informant's life hangs by a thread.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Los Zopilotes are en route to the warehouse, while Roxana gets a warning. The battle between the cartels begins, and Rodiles' merchandise is at stake.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Don Jesús gives Alicia 24 hours to poison Roxana in exchange for her mother's life. To succeed, she needs to overcome Puma's control.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Roxana has plans to get revenge on Los Zopilotes. She begins by sowing distrust between el Rey and el Habanero, and is willing to go great lengths.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Roxana pushes to get the information she needs. She alerts Alan and Ricardo that the police are spying on them, and pulls strings to silence Ferrer.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Morillo watches closely, but is intercepted and is threatened with evidence against him. Now he must execute his mission in his own police station.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Diego has evidence to ruin Ferrer, who must justify his actions after hitting a subordinate. Morillo furthers his mission, but is surprised.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The truck is ready to load the goods. When she notices some changes, Lidia gets nervous. Roxana and her allies follow her with a tracker.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Ferrer is questioned and breaks when he recalls David. He is unsure where he will be transferred, and Roxana gets him placed where it suits her best.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Ferrer gets to Las Dunas and asks to be isolated. Rumors that he is a dealer and a murderer spread in the prison. Roxana and the agent exchange looks.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Alejandro urges Roxana to seize the opportunity to kill him. Overcome by her emotions, she claims that he murdered the person she loved most.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Ustáriz and his men are ready to launch the operation. Morillo completes his mission to clear the motel, but the police arrive early.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: In the mine, the exchange of money for weapons is about to happen. Don Jesús has doubts and suggests that they leave before receiving the shipment.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Carmen Govea visits her colleague Ferrer in prison, and the visit turns into an interrogation. Manuel cannot believe what he hears from Govea.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ferrer has a strategy in prison, while Roxana gets carried away by passion one night when she tries to leave the business and its pressure behind.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Roxana is willing to pay anything for the merchandise she needs to meet the demand. Martín tries to negotiate, but it's not just about money anymore.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Don Jesús works on discovering who ratted out Los Zopilotes' movements and has a plan to find out. Roxana wants to gain ground with the Colombians.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Rodiles prepares her next play outside Las Dunas and pressures the prison director to think of two or three options as she sends her men to Palenque.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Roxana's men arrive at Palenque armed to the teeth. Javi, the Sergeant and his men are ready to attack, while Don Jesús continues with his plan.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: A power outage is a perfect excuse for a maintenance team to enter Las Dunas. Rosendo is the guide and ally for the operation that has already begun.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Martín is in charge of intercepting John Jairo, whom he whisks away, hooded and at gunpoint, to an unknown spot. His boss's orders no longer matter.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Roxana finds out that the intercepted cell phone could be in Ferrer's hands, so she orders a search and is willing to do whatever it takes to find it.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: About to be released, Alicia offers her help to Rodiles to go after Don Jesús in return for the favors received. The inmates bid her a warm farewell.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Los Zopilotes gather to organize a plot. El Rey brings in his men and announces they will avenge el Habanero's betrayal and Berebere's crime.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Rodiles hears of a committee visit to the prison from the Pastor. While unsure of the details, she detects a plot with Ferrer that upsets her plans.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: The Pastor finds a document and draws conclusions that lead him to Las Dunas; he only needs proof to confirm his suspicions. Rodiles fears the worst.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Rodiles sends her best man to find out how much Ferrer knows about the doll business. The Pastor is paid an unexpected and complicated visit.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Amid the mutiny and cries for Cordero's immediate exit, la Mariscala exploits the women's confinement and attacks Rodiles and her allies.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: The Zopilotes are ready to torture Martín to get information from him. Javi explains to Don Jesús his ties with Rodiles, who asks Alicia for help.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Roxana cannot escape the pressure, although she has certain privileges. Rodiles tasks Puma with guarding her lair and investigating who is in charge.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: El Picheleiro loses his temper and unleashes his anger against Rodiles. The Italians question the quality and quantity of the goods and refuse to pay.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Roxana no longer trusts anyone and checks the quality of the drug herself. With help from Eladia and Rosendo, she still must hurry to not get caught.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Guided by the tracker and Roxana's instructions, Martín's rescue operation advances. At the same time, Morillo arrives with police backup.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Javi tries to distract Morillo, but while walking through the warehouse, shooting breaks out. Roxana orders Rivera not to risk Martín's life.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: For adulterating Rodiles' goods, el Cóndor is forced to fulfill a mission in Las Dunas. Martín, under Roxana's orders, sends him a deadly substance.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: El Cóndor and Pelos ambush Ferrer in the bathroom. El Habanero soon arrives, and the clash with police spreads. Strategy is worth more than strength.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Los Zopilotes' boss likes newbies like Alicia, who promises to seduce him with lace and see-throughs. But the preparations take longer than expected.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Don Jesús' call reveals a meeting with el Picheleiro in Mexico. Roxana plays her hand in prison, and a cafeteria fight leads her to Captain Diaz.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: El Picheleiro arrives in Mexico to meet Don Jesús and to close the deal in person. As for Roxana, surrounded by accomplices, she is ready to escape.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Rodiles is in possession of the best weapon to pressure El Picheleiro: a confidential list of figures in Spain stuffing their pockets with his help.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Ferrer puts the pieces together and shares his findings about Roxana on TV, igniting a scandal and breaking up her cartel.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: With all the account information in his hands, Martín ousts Roxana and searches out El Picheleiro to introduce his right-hand man to Don Jesús.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Roxana is recaptured and put in a new cell block, where she's left at the mercy of her enemies inside the prison.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Rodiles' extradition to the US is a reality, but a visit disrupts the transfer. In an emotional farewell, Roxana separates from her collaborators.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Ferrer and Morillo enlist hostages to make the exchange. The meeting point is set, but Martín, Javi and the Sergeant have an ace up their sleeve.
